turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste, main aapki madad karne ke liye yahan hoon, bataiye kya problem hai?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Mera card ka limit badhana hai, kya aap EMI Plus ya VeloVishwas se check karwa sakte ho?

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Haan bilkul, ab hum credit limit Direct aur savings account Classic dekh rahe hain, VeloRupya bhi consider karenge.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Bas ye confirm karo ki BBPS Easy se payment ho jayega kya?

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Ji haan, cheque Flex aur MorKharcha dono se aapka request process ho jayega, bas thoda wait kariye.
